ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning:
The cancellation was made by the rider, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-4 [F2][NS-0]. The trace settles the timing element: the rider cancelled 175 s (2 min 55 s) after matching, i.e. within 3 minutes [F2], so the NS-4 free-cancellation branch applies and the $6.61 fee is not chargeable [F5][NS-4].

The driver-side no-show route cannot support the fee either. The driver never tapped "I'm Here" and no automatic arrival was logged [F4], and the driver was never within 200 m of the pickup (closest approach 2189 m at the moment of cancellation) [F1][F3]. NS-1 (i) and (ii) therefore fail, and under NS-2 the $6.61 must be returned in full [NS-1][NS-2]. The driver's own written statement, made after the trip, only says he was "on my way" [F10], which is consistent with the GPS record [F1] and does not create any fee entitlement.

The driver's 14:06 chat message giving "5 min more" [F8] confirms he was still far from the pickup about one minute before the cancellation [F2][F1], so the >3 continuous minutes of waiting at the pickup that NS-1 (iii) requires could not have occurred [NS-1]. The chat record is complete and fully timestamped [F9], so this is not a G12 referral situation and the record settles every element above.

No traffic excuse is available or needed: the speed band on Stevens Road (30–39 km/h) and the absence of incidents and rain, in fair weather [F11][F12][F13], satisfy neither RD-4(a) nor RD-4(b), and in any event the fee issue is governed by NS-4 [RD-4].

Amount: the only money in issue is the single cancellation fee of $6.61 with a 1.0× multiplier and no surge [F5][F6]; no trip was performed. The refund is the whole $6.61 [F2][F5][NS-4][NS-7], payable as a Ryde voucher per NS-7.

On the safety screen, I read the complaint, both chat messages and the driver's statement: they concern arrival time and the cancellation fee only, with no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark, or dangerous-driving allegation [F7][F8][F10]. Nothing in the record suggests an account-level abuse of the arrival/cancellation button: no "I'm Here" tap and no fabricated arrival exist [F3][F4][F5], so NS-2's flag_account limb is not triggered.
